notes: Extract the raw eftn3lo result; Higgs XS and R_LO*eftn3lo include a finite-top Born rescaling absent from HJMiNNLO pure HEFT.
The production build adapts only the hard alpha_s to LHAPDF alphasQ(muR) in an isolated source copy. Benchmark the unmodified source separately.
The native HJMiNNLO hybrid HOPPET evolution uses three-loop alpha_s reconstructed from the NNLO PDF at MZ. The inclusive normalization intentionally upgrades to four-loop alpha_s with aN3LO QED PDFs.
Multiply every pure-QCD EFT result and its numerical error by [GF*pi/(sqrt(2)*288)*GeV^-2_to_pb]/35.0309 to match the POWHEG GF convention.
Use the seven standard scale points and all 100 PDF replicas before publishing the record. The stored production cross section excludes the branching fraction and detector response.
